title: Virtual Compute: evt incident
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closing time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report. No customer statement substitutes for the report. Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though the outage service-credit basis excludes them. Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for evt incident?**

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closing time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report.
